LandscapeMaterialService.create_auto_material:
X.create_auto_material(landscape_name_or_label, material_name, material_path, layer_configs, auto_blend=True, height_threshold=5000.000000, height_blend=1000.000000, slope_threshold=35.000000, slope_blend=10.000000) -> LandscapeAutoMaterialResult
Create a complete landscape material with automatic layer blending.
Maps to action="create_auto_material"

Creates a material with LandscapeLayerBlend, texture samplers,
and optional height/slope auto-blend masks. Also creates layer info
objects and assigns the material to the target landscape.

Layer roles control auto-blend behavior:
 - "base"   — Default layer, shown on low/flat terrain
 - "slope"  — Shown on steep terrain via WorldAlignedNormal mask
 - "height" — Shown at high elevation via WorldPosition mask
 - "paint"  — Manual paint only (no auto-blending)

Args:
    landscape_name_or_label (str): Name/label of target landscape (empty = don't assign)
    material_name (str): Name for the new material asset
    material_path (str): Directory path where material will be created
    layer_configs (Array[LandscapeAutoLayerConfig]): Array of layer configurations
    auto_blend (bool): If true, wire height/slope masks for layers with those roles
    height_threshold (float): World Z height where height layer begins
    height_blend (float): Transition width for height blending
    slope_threshold (float): Slope angle where slope layer begins (degrees)
    slope_blend (float): Transition width for slope blending (degrees)

Returns:
    LandscapeAutoMaterialResult: Result with material path, layer info paths, and any errors

Create a LandscapeGrassOutput expression for procedural grass/foliage spawning.

Each entry in GrassTypeNames maps a display name to a grass type asset path.
The node will have one input per grass type for driving spawn density.

Returns:

LandscapeMaterialService.create_height_mask_node:
X.create_height_mask_node(material_path, min_height, max_height, pos_x=-1200, pos_y=0) -> str
Create a height-based mask node network in the material graph.
Maps to action="create_height_mask"

Builds: AbsoluteWorldPosition → ComponentMask(B/Z) → SmoothStep
Output: 0 below MinHeight, smooth S-curve transition, 1 above MaxHeight.

Use the returned expression ID as an Alpha input on an LB_AlphaBlend layer
to blend a layer in above a certain elevation — e.g., snow above 8000 units.
No weight-map painting required; the material handles it automatically.

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material asset
    min_height (float): World Z where mask begins rising from 0 (world units)
    max_height (float): World Z where mask reaches 1 (world units)
    pos_x (int32): X position of the output node in the material graph
    pos_y (int32): Y position of the output node

Returns:
    str: Expression ID of the SmoothStep output node, or empty string on failure Example: mask_id = svc.create_height_mask("/Game/M_Terrain", 5000.0, 8000.0) svc.connect_to_layer_input("/Game/M_Terrain", mask_id, "", blend_id, "Snow", "Alpha")

LandscapeMaterialService.create_slope_mask_node:
X.create_slope_mask_node(material_path, min_slope_degrees=30.000000, max_slope_degrees=60.000000, pos_x=-1200, pos_y=300) -> str
Create a slope-based mask node network in the material graph.
Maps to action="create_slope_mask"

Builds: VertexNormalWS → ComponentMask(B/Z) → OneMinus → SmoothStep
Output: 0 for flat terrain (below MinSlopeDegrees), 1 for steep/cliff terrain
(above MaxSlopeDegrees).

WorldNormal.Z = cos(slope_angle):
  Flat (0°)     → NormalZ ≈ 1.0 → SlopeFactor ≈ 0
  Vertical (90°) → NormalZ ≈ 0.0 → SlopeFactor ≈ 1

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material asset
    min_slope_degrees (float): Slope angle below which mask = 0 (flat terrain)
    max_slope_degrees (float): Slope angle above which mask = 1 (cliff terrain)
    pos_x (int32): X position of the output node
    pos_y (int32): Y position of the output node

Returns:
    str: Expression ID of the SmoothStep output node, or empty string on failure Example: mask_id = svc.create_slope_mask("/Game/M_Terrain", 30.0, 60.0) svc.connect_to_layer_input("/Game/M_Terrain", mask_id, "", blend_id, "Rock", "Alpha")

LandscapeMaterialService.setup_height_slope_blend:
X.setup_height_slope_blend(material_path, blend_node_id, base_layer_name, height_layer_name="", slope_layer_name="", height_threshold=5000.000000, height_blend=1000.000000, slope_threshold=35.000000, slope_blend=10.000000) -> bool
Set up a complete height/slope-driven layer blend in one call.
Maps to action="setup_height_slope_blend"

Switches the specified layers in an existing LandscapeLayerBlend node to
LB_AlphaBlend mode, then creates height and/or slope mask networks and
connects them as the Alpha input for each layer.

This replaces runtime weight-map painting for elevation/slope zones with a
fully procedural material solution — no painting tools needed.

Layer zones:
  BaseLayerName  - Displays on low, flat terrain (no alpha mask; weight blend)
  HeightLayerName - Fades in above HeightThreshold (e.g., snow on peaks)
  SlopeLayerName  - Fades in above SlopeThreshold degrees (e.g., rock on cliffs)

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material
    blend_node_id (str): Existing LandscapeLayerBlend node to configure
    base_layer_name (str): Layer for low/flat terrain (kept as LB_WeightBlend)
    height_layer_name (str): Layer for high-altitude zones. Empty = skip.
    slope_layer_name (str): Layer for steep-slope zones. Empty = skip.
    height_threshold (float): World Z where height layer begins to appear (world units)
    height_blend (float): Transition width above threshold (world units)
    slope_threshold (float): Slope angle where slope layer begins to appear (degrees)
    slope_blend (float): Transition width above threshold (degrees)

Returns:
    bool: True if setup succeeded Example: # Create blend node with three layers blend = svc.create_layer_blend_node_with_layers(mat, [grass_cfg, snow_cfg, rock_cfg]) # Wire height/slope masks automatically — no painting needed svc.setup_height_slope_blend(mat, blend.node_id, base_layer_name="Grass", height_layer_name="Snow", height_threshold=8000.0, height_blend=2000.0, slope_layer_name="Rock",  slope_threshold=35.0,    slope_blend=10.0)
